name: Lizard Squad
description: Lizard Squad was a hacking group best known for taking down Xbox Live and PlayStation Network on Christmas Day 2014 with DDoS attacks. The group ran a DDoS-for-hire service called LizardStresser powered by hacked home routers. Several members were arrested in 2015, and the group's infrastructure was subsequently hacked and exposed.

sources.title: Lizard Kids: A Long Trail of Fail — Krebs on Security
